meaning.en: To deliberately avoid thinking about, accepting or dealing with an unpleasant fact, danger or problem, even though it may affect you.
meaning.zh: 明知有令人不快的事實、危險或問題，卻刻意逃避，不願思考、接受或處理。
naturalZh: 明知有問題卻拒絕處理

benefits.en: The idiom compresses a longer explanation into one recognised expression.
benefits.zh: 他正在逃避現實。 這個慣用語把較長的解釋濃縮成一個固定表達。

examples.en: He is burying his head in the sand.
examples.zh: 他正在逃避現實。
examples.highlight: burying his head in the sand

benefits.en: This sentence does more than describe inaction. It warns the listener that continued avoidance is unwise.
benefits.zh: 不要再逃避現實。 這句不只是描述沒有行動，還警告聽者繼續逃避並不明智。

benefits.en: Don’t bury your head in the sand.; You cannot keep burying your head in the sand.; There is no point in burying your head in the sand.; Rather than burying your head in the sand, ask for help.
benefits.zh: 這些句式可以勸告別人正視問題及尋求協助。

benefits.en: The expression can show that the speaker has recognised a previous mistake.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以表示說話者已意識到自己過往的錯誤。

benefits.en: avoid reality; face and deal with it. The idiom is useful, but it is not automatically better than ignore, avoid or refuse to deal with in every context. Model Examples Elena knew that the roof was leaking, but she kept acting as if no repair was needed. The idiom replaces the longer explanation that she knowingly acted as if the problem did not need attention. Ignoring the warning will not make the danger disappear. Here, the entire idiom acts as the subject.
benefits.zh: 這個句式清楚呈現兩個選擇： 這個慣用語十分實用，但並非在所有語境中都一定比 ignore、avoid 或 refuse to deal with 更好。 埃琳娜知道屋頂漏水，卻一直假裝不需要維修。 埃琳娜對屋頂漏水的問題採取逃避態度。 答案保留了埃琳娜、屋頂漏水、過去時態，以及她刻意逃避的態度。 無視警告並不會令危險消失。 逃避現實並不會令危險消失。 在這個例子中，整個慣用語作為句子的主語。

examples.en: Elena buried her head in the sand over the leaking roof.
examples.zh: 埃琳娜對屋頂漏水的問題採取逃避態度。
examples.highlight: buried her head in the sand

examples.en: Burying your head in the sand will not make the danger disappear.
examples.zh: 逃避現實並不會令危險消失。
examples.highlight: Burying your head in the sand

origin.statusEn: Ancient Source of the Image; Exact English Origin Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 意象具有古代來源；確切英語形式的起源不明

history.en: Pliny the Elder described an ostrich hiding its head and neck among bushes and supposedly believing that the rest of its body was concealed. His account referred to bushes rather than sand, but it records an ancient version of the same mistaken idea.
history.zh: 古羅馬作家老普林尼曾描述鴕鳥把頭和頸藏在灌木中，並誤以為整個身體已被遮掩。 他的記載提到的是灌木而不是沙，但已記錄了同一錯誤觀念的古代版本。

history.en: The mistaken picture became a metaphor for people who refuse to look at a problem and behave as though it does not exist.
history.zh: 這個錯誤畫面後來成為一個比喻，用來描述拒絕正視問題，並假裝問題不存在的人。

origin.memoryEn: Hiding your view of a problem does not hide the problem itself.
origin.memoryZh: 遮住自己看問題的視線，並不會把問題本身遮住。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：問題必須令人不快
rules.en: He knows the business is losing money, but he refuses to examine the figures. He forgot where he put his pen. Forgetting a small fact is not normally burying one’s head in the sand.
rules.zh: 他知道公司正在虧損，卻拒絕查看數字。 他忘記把筆放在哪裏。 忘記一件小事通常不屬於逃避現實。

rules.titleEn: The Person Must Know or Have Reason to Know
rules.titleZh: 規則二：當事人必須知道或有理由知道問題存在
rules.en: The idiom usually suggests that warning signs or facts are already available. Carmen cannot be accused of avoiding information she never received.
rules.zh: 這個慣用語通常表示警告跡象或事實已經存在。 如果從未有人告訴卡門會議有改動，便不能指責她逃避自己從未收到的資訊。

rules.titleEn: It Means Avoidance, Not Simple Delay
rules.titleZh: 規則三：它表示逃避，而不只是合理延遲
rules.en: Refusing to examine clear facts because they are unpleasant may be burying one’s head in the sand.
rules.zh: 因為事實令人不快而拒絕查看清楚證據，才可能屬於逃避現實。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：不要增加確定程度
rules.en: The incorrect version changes a possibility into a conclusion.
rules.zh: 錯誤版本把一個可能性改成了確定結論。

rules.en: Do not change a past action into a present habit.
rules.zh: 不要把過去行為改成現在習慣。

rules.titleZh: 規則六：所有格必須配合主語
規則七：配合單數及複數
規則八：In the Sand 必須保持不變
rules.zh: In the Sand 必須保持不變

rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要按字面解讀
rules.en: The child buried a toy head in the sand. The exercise uses only the figurative meaning.
rules.zh: 孩子把玩具頭埋在沙中。 投訴出現時，經理選擇逃避問題。 本練習只使用比喻意思。

examples.en: The manager buried his head in the sand when complaints arrived.
examples.zh: 投訴出現時，經理選擇逃避問題。
examples.highlight: buried his head in the sand

rules.titleZh: 規則十：避免重複解釋相同意思
rules.en: The final clause simply repeats the idiom’s core meaning. A specific external fact may remain, but the general meaning “refused to face reality” should not be repeated unnecessarily.
rules.zh: 最後一個子句只是再次解釋慣用語本身。 他對未繳帳單的問題採取逃避態度。 可以保留具體問題，但不應在使用慣用語後，再無必要地重複「拒絕面對現實」。

examples.en: He buried his head in the sand over the unpaid bills.
examples.zh: 他對未繳帳單的問題採取逃避態度。
examples.highlight: buried his head in the sand

rules.titleZh: 規則十一：這個表達通常帶有批評意味
rules.en: This may sound direct or accusatory. Choose the tone according to the relationship.
rules.zh: 這句可能聽起來直接，甚至帶有指責意味。 我擔心你可能正在逃避問題。 應按說話者之間的關係選擇語氣。

examples.en: I’m worried that you may be burying your head in the sand.
examples.zh: 我擔心你可能正在逃避問題。
examples.highlight: burying your head in the sand

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Every Form of Inaction
rules.titleZh: 規則十二：不要把所有不採取行動的情況都套用這個表達
rules.en: they need more information; they are waiting for permission; another problem is more urgent; they do not yet know what happened. Use the idiom only when the delay involves refusing to face an unpleasant fact or problem.
rules.zh: 以上情況並不一定表示逃避現實。 只有當延誤涉及拒絕面對令人不快的事實或問題時，才應使用這個慣用語。

instructions.en: bury one’s head in the sand
instructions.zh: 使用 bury one’s head in the sand 的適當形式改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: The council says that it needs more facts. However, after three clear reports, many residents believe that it is simply refusing to face the problem.
questions.promptZh: 議會表示需要更多資料。不過，在已有三份清楚報告後，許多居民認為它只是在拒絕面對問題。
questions.answer: The council says that it needs more facts, but after three clear reports, many residents believe that it is burying its head in the sand.
questions.answerZh: 議會表示需要更多資料，但在已有三份清楚報告後，許多居民認為它正在逃避問題。
